scoreboard_title: Only Skintific's TikTok views moved beyond normal this week
movers_title: Skintific's share of TikTok views jumped to 5.9%

drivers.title: Mega creators and a new launch lifted Skintific's reach
drivers.why: Two mega creators posted Skintific's new launch to 1.7M and 971K views, and a nano account with 5K followers drew 2.9M across three posts. Views rose from 1.2M to 10.9M while panel TikTok views grew 11%.
drivers.attention_to_action: The reach came from posts without cart links, and cart share rose only to 31%. The selling ran through the sale tag: 28 creators on #dealsforyoudays.

actions.title: Post fewer, bigger TikToks from brand accounts
actions.detail: Paragon's 449 brand-account TikToks drew 19.5M views at a 3K median; Hanasui's 34 drew 20.2M at a 132K median. Cut the weakest daily posts and put media behind two or three hero videos a week.

actions.title: Pair a big-name reveal with a nano wave
actions.detail: Mega creators are 1% of Paragon's creator posts but 22% of its views, and Skintific's launch rode two big posts. Book one Mega reveal for Make Over's next launch and let Nano creators carry the volume.

actions.title: Join the platform sale tag with carts on
actions.detail: Skintific held 88% of #dealsforyoudays posts with 28 creators while its cart share rose to 31%. For the next TikTok Shop campaign, brief creators to use the tag and the cart together.

actions.title: Read Make Over's TikTok wave before scaling it
actions.detail: Make Over's TikTok posts rose from 156 to 844, 9.9% of the panel, while its Instagram fell to 58. Look at the wave's cart share and its repeat posters before adding budget.

actions.title: Test a moisturizer-led creator brief
actions.detail: Hanasui's 29 moisturizer posts drew 8.4M views and its ceramide gel sat in the cart on 21 posts. Pilot a Wardah moisturizer brief with ten creators and compare views per post against lip.

portfolio_note: Make Over's TikTok posts rose from 156 to 844, and Wardah's TikTok engagement rate reached 7.4%.

tiers.title: Mega posts gave Paragon 22% of its creator views from 1%
tiers.takeaway: Paragon's Mega creators are 1% of its creator posts but 22% of views; Mid-tier adds 31% from 4%. Nano is 83% of posts for 29%.

products.title: Hanasui's moisturizer gel and Skintific's serum drew views on few posts
products.takeaway: Hanasui's 29 moisturizer posts drew 8.4M views and its ceramide gel sits in the cart on 21 posts; Paragon's 613 lip posts drew 13.8M.

posting.title: Paragon's peak day carried 32% of its views
posting.takeaway: TikTok capture rose 206% this week, so read volumes with care; Skintific landed 36% of its views on one day.
